query: I have a 60‑year‑old female with asthma exacerbation. Among female inpatients aged 55–65, what is the 95th percentile of the lab instability score in the first 48 hours? For that top tier, report LOS, mortality, and critical lab rate versus general inpatients.
final_sql: SELECT percentile_cont(0.95) within GROUP (ORDER BY f.value) AS percentile_value, f.los, f.deathtime, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN f.value > 1 THEN f.hadm_id END) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT g.hadm_id), 0) AS critical_rate, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN g.value > 1 THEN g.hadm_id END) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT f.hadm_id), 0) AS general_rate FROM f FULL JOIN g G ON f.hadm_id = g.hadm_id GROUP BY f.los, f.deathtime;
